# The Great Lakes Center for Education Research and Practice

> > A nonprofit education research organization providing evidence-based policy analysis, research reviews, and advocacy on school funding, equity, and public education reform.

Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, the Great Lakes Center conducts rigorous education research and translates findings into actionable policy briefs and opinion pieces for educators, policymakers, and advocates. The organization is known for its Think Twice program that critically evaluates education policy claims and its publications on school segregation, special education, charter schools, and education equity.

## Core Programs & Research

- [The Great Lakes Center for Education Research and Practice](https://www.greatlakescenter.org): Homepage introducing Great Lakes Center's education research and key programs
- [Think Twice – Research Review Program](https://www.greatlakescenter.org/think-twice): Think Twice program for reviewing education policy research and programs
- [Think Twice Weekly Reports](http://greatlakescenter.org/docs/Think_Twice/weekly/tt_reports.php): Archive index of Think Twice weekly reports organized by year
- [About – Organization & Staff](https://www.greatlakescenter.org/about): Organization mission, board members, and staff directory of Great Lakes Center

## Policy Analysis & Commentary

- [Policy Briefs](https://www.greatlakescenter.org/policy-brief): Policy briefs on education funding, teacher professionalism, and school discipline
- [Op-Ed Pieces](https://www.greatlakescenter.org/op-ed): Opinion pieces on education policy, community schools, and student mental health
- [News & Updates](https://www.greatlakescenter.org/news): News archive covering education policy, school funding, and AI in education
